about:
# Notepad
Notes for levels and users. Because that's apparently the hot new thing everyone's been wanting, lately.

Markdown supported.

Things are in beta; the UX (one line input box) might be a bit less than ideal at the moment.

This [Geode mod](https://geode-sdk.org) is licensed under LGPLv2. To report bugs or get help with using my mods, press the Discord button in the lower left corner.

# Notepad Changelog
## v1.0.2
- Minor refactors.
## v1.0.1
- Added  `Ctrl+S`  /  `Cmd+S`  note-saving shortcut <co>FOR DESKTOP USERS</c> <c-ff0000>***__ONLY__***</c>.
  - This keybind is <c-ff0000>***__NOT__***</c> rebindable, and remains as such.
- Added support to add notes for unregistered users.
  - Note that <cl>BetterInfo</c> and <cl>Alpha's Geode Utils</c> are <c-ff0000>***__REQUIRED__***</c> for this feature.

<mod:cvolton.betterinfo>

<mod:alphalaneous.alphas_geode_utils>

- Refactored a bit of the code to use template classes.

- Initial release (on GitHub).
